title: Figures 15–16. Peak IR Wavelength and Peak Shock Layer Temperature vs. Mach Number
description: Two line charts plotted against Mach number (0 to 100). Figure 15, "Peak Wavelength of Emitted Radiation," shows peak wavelength in microns dropping steeply with Mach number, with dashed lines and an arrow annotated "Typical Satellite IR Systems Measure Radiation from 2.5 to 5 microns." Figure 16, "Temperature Downstream of a Normal Shock," shows temperature rising linearly to about 30,000 K, annotated that above 550 C (823 K) ionization and dissociation of oxygen and nitrogen lead to lower temperatures behind the bow shock.
